notion.authentication: per-user OAuth via existing native login flow
notion.version: hosted service; discover tools at connection time
notion.license: hosted provider terms; no server package redistributed
notion.scope_policy: Review provider consent and discovered read/write tools; connection is not write authorization
notion.acceptance: configuration only; new live login unverified

canva.authentication: registered app OAuth client and per-user authorization
canva.scope_policy: Provider client registration and user consent; generation may require a paid plan
canva.acceptance: blocked until deployment client registration and native OAuth compatibility are verified; existing configurations are retained verbatim

google.authentication: deployment OAuth client and separate owner credentials
google.license: MIT; community implementation, not an official Google server
google.scope_policy: Review selected Workspace tools and their OAuth scopes; no domain-wide delegation preset
google.acceptance: requires installed pinned runtime and owner adapter acceptance; no install or connection by default

microsoft.authentication: owner-bound Microsoft account; existing full Microsoft 365 capability retained
microsoft.license: MIT; community implementation, not an official Microsoft server
microsoft.scope_policy: Review installed tool preset and Graph delegated permissions; no admin token inheritance
microsoft.acceptance: package release discovered, not installed or validated; requires host runtime acceptance
